C0722.title: Fast Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuned Models for LLM Hallucination Detection
C0722.summary: This study highlights that LLMs can produce hallucinations in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, leading to decisions based on incorrect information. It proposes a fine-tuned model ensemble for hallucination detection, distinguishing between faithfulness hallucinations and factual hallucinations, which pose serious risks in safety-critical applications.
